name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-custom-forest
title: Super Mario All-Stars - Custom Forest
description:
This tileset was based in some stuff from Super Mario Maker 2 in Super Mario Bros. from NES mode, from some other tilesets.
Now, it was completely created in the Super Mario All-Stars style!

The Background and Layer 3 contains three other palette variants plus the default one, that means you have four options.

And the Foreground has only one palette variant plus the default one, resulting in two options.

NOTE: If you use the Layer 3, you still can use the vanilla status bar normally if your level doesn't have vertical scrolling, and along with the background obviously.
But it's most recommended that you use some alternate patch that modifies the status bar mechanics.

Here are some examples:
DKCR Styled Sprite Status Bar
New Super Mario Bros. Wii Styled Status Bar
Remove Status Bar
RAM Toggled Status Bar (& IRQ)

Ripped from these sheets:
SMAS Custom Forest Background
SMAS Custom Forest Tileset

Both made by SuperSledgeBro, and some extra stuff/modifications by me.

Enjoy!
